correctness.rationale: For 2-by-2 matrices the exact identity \(\|A\|_4^4=\|A\|_2^4-2|\det A|^2\) reduces an alleged Hilbertian three-space to a Hermitian quadratic form and one holomorphic quadratic determinant. Positivity gives H at least I; after diagonalization, coordinate-torus invariance forces the determinant polynomial to one monomial, and coefficient comparison rules out every nonzero degree-two monomial. The resulting all-singular three-dimensional image contradicts the direct determinant proof that a complex singular subspace of M_2 has dimension at most two. Rank-one row maps prove sharpness.

value.rationale: The claim computes a natural exact geometric invariant—the maximal complex Hilbertian dimension of the smallest nontrivial Schatten-4 matrix space—and simultaneously determines the first higher-dimensional Hilbertian target size left outside the focal two-dimensional classification. It distinguishes a genuine target-dimension obstruction from the already-known admissibility of the Hilbert exponent and supplies a reusable determinant-polynomial mechanism for low matrix size.
